info.title: Factory Public API
info.description: Public API for Factory platform. Requires authentication via the `Authorization: Bearer` header.

post.summary: Open a CI workflow PR (create / edit / delete)

get.summary: List GitHub Actions runs for CI automation workflows

schema.description: Whether to include provisioning step details.
Whether to include Computers hidden from normal listings.

get.description: Returns the computers owned by the authenticated client, ordered newest first. Provisioning steps are included only when `includeProvisioningSteps=true`.

post.description: Creates a computer. Managed computers are returned in a provisioning state and set up asynchronously; BYOM computers register an existing machine and are active immediately.

Creates up to 20 identical managed computers with server-assigned names (`<namePrefix>-<n>`, lowest free suffixes). Creation is fail-fast without rollback: on a mid-batch failure the response is still 201 with the computers created so far plus an `error` describing the failure.

get.description: Returns the authenticated caller's computer with the given name.
Returns the managed compute providers currently available for new computers in the authenticated organization.
Returns a computer by ID. Callers can access their own computers; organization members with the manager role or higher can also access service-account-owned computers.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a computer. Deleting a managed computer also shuts down its hosted environment and archives its sessions; deleting a BYOM computer removes the registration but leaves the machine and its sessions intact. Automations running on the computer are paused.

patch.description: Updates a computer's name or remote user. A host ID can be assigned to a computer that does not have one; host IDs are immutable once set and must be unique among the owner's computers.

post.description: Completes a file upload by writing the previously uploaded file into the computer's workspace. Returns `409 Conflict` if a file with that name already exists.
Creates a download for a file in the computer's workspace and returns a time-limited download URL.
Starts a file upload to a computer. Returns a time-limited upload URL and form fields; upload the file there, then call complete-upload to place it in the computer's workspace.

Starts a new dependency-installation attempt on a managed computer that was configured to install dependencies. Installation runs in the background; returns `202 Accepted` with the updated computer, or `409 Conflict` when an install is already in progress.

get.description: Returns CPU, memory, and disk usage metrics for an active managed computer. Not supported for BYOM computers.

post.description: Refreshes the Git credentials and user-owned computer secrets on a managed computer. BYOM computers are not modified and return zero counts.

Ensures an active managed computer is running, resuming it if necessary. Computers that are already running are left untouched and reported with `wasRestarted: false`. Not supported for BYOM computers.

schema.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of enterprise control setting changes for the organization, ordered by revision descending. Properties for the `settings` object may be added, removed, or renamed between API versions. Clients should parse it as a generic JSON object.
Returns the global per-user credits limit for the organization. This limit applies to all users who do not have an individual override.

put.description: Set the global per-user credits limit for the organization. This limit applies to all users who do not have an individual override. Pass null to remove the global limit.

get.description: Returns the global per-user credits limit and any individual user overrides for the organization.

put.description: Set individual per-user credits limits for one or more users. Supports bulk updates (up to 100 users per request). Identify each user by email. Pass null for limit to remove an individual override.

schema.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users in the Factory organization.

schema.description: Email address of the user to remove

delete.description: Removes a user from the organization by email. Works for both active members (deletes membership) and pending invitations (revokes the invite).

post.description: Sends an invitation to a user to join the organization. If the user is already a member, updates their role to the specified value. If the user has a pending invite, returns the current status without changes. If the organization has reached its seat limit, returns status "error" with a descriptive error message.

get.description: Returns all service accounts in the authenticated organization. Requires human authentication with a Manager role or higher; service account credentials are rejected.

post.description: Creates a new service account in the authenticated organization. Requires human authentication with a Manager role or higher; service account credentials are rejected.

get.description: Returns a single service account by ID. Requires human authentication with a Manager role or higher; service account credentials are rejected.

patch.description: Updates a service account description or status. Name is immutable. Requires human authentication with a Manager role or higher; service account credentials are rejected.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a service account. Tears down all computers owned by the SA and purges stored git credentials (best-effort). Requires human authentication with a Manager role or higher; service account credentials are rejected.

get.description: Returns all API keys for a service account, active and inactive. Each item carries `isRevoked`, `expiresAt`, and `revokedAt` so clients can split them into active/inactive views.

post.summary: Create a service account API key
post.description: Mints a new API key for a service account and returns the one-time key value. The value is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.

post.summary: Revoke a service account API key
post.description: Revokes an API key for a service account. Once revoked, the key can no longer authenticate. Idempotent.

post.summary: Rotate a service account API key
post.description: DESTRUCTIVE: atomically revokes the existing key and issues a replacement that inherits its name, returning the new one-time key value (shown only once). The previous key stops authenticating the instant this call succeeds, so any client still using it will immediately start failing with 401. Update every consumer with the new value before rotating, or set `gracePeriodMinutes` to keep the old key valid for a short overlap window.

schema.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of sessions for the authenticated user. This feature is enabled for selected organizations only.

post.description: Creates a new session with the specified configuration. This feature is enabled for selected organizations only.

get.description: Returns detailed session information including settings and stats. This feature is enabled for selected organizations only.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a session (can be restored within retention period). This feature is enabled for selected organizations only.

patch.description: Updates session configuration such as model and reasoning effort. This feature is enabled for selected organizations only.

post.description: Interrupts a running agent loop. Idempotent if already idle. This feature is enabled for selected organizations only.

schema.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100)

get.description: Returns paginated message history with optional role filtering. This feature is enabled for selected organizations only.

post.summary: Add a message to a session
post.description: Adds a user message and optionally waits for agent completion. Supports text, images, and file attachments. This feature is enabled for selected organizations only.

get.description: Returns a single message from the session by its ID. This feature is enabled for selected organizations only.

get.summary: List wiki run history for a repository

post.summary: Create a wiki video upload URL

get.summary: Export a wiki run as a zip
